subject.title: fix(agents): bound IDENTITY.md reads to prevent OOM

question: Should parsed workspace `IDENTITY.md` metadata deliberately adopt the strict final-path symlink rejection, or preserve the metadata loader's previous symlink-following behavior?
rationale: The helper strengthens the file boundary but changes an existing accepted path shape, so permanent policy requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt strict workspace policy
options.body: Reject final-path symlinks consistently, add explicit rejection coverage, and document the intentional upgrade behavior in the PR context.

options.title: Preserve symlink compatibility
options.body: Use a bounded reader that retains the previous final-path symlink behavior while enforcing the shared byte cap.

recommendation.title: Adopt strict workspace policy
recommendation.body: Reject final-path symlinks consistently, add explicit rejection coverage, and document the intentional upgrade behavior in the PR context.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest historical ownership signal for the identity behavior and central files.
